# scene01.txt — A Cat in a Girls' Dormitory
# Story: A stray cat sneaks into a cozy dormitory and meets its residents.

SET emi_affection 0
SET sara_affection 0

BG assets/backgrounds/dorm_entrance.png
SPRITE assets/sprites/cat_hero.png center

SAY Narrator It was a cold, rainy evening when you first saw the golden light spilling from the dormitory window.
SAY Narrator You're just a small, hungry stray, but the smell of grilled salmon is calling your name.

BG assets/backgrounds/hallway.png
SAY Narrator You slip through a cracked door. The hallway is warm and smells like vanilla and old books.

BG assets/backgrounds/lounge.png
SPRITE assets/sprites/emi_surprised.png center
SAY Emi Eek! A... a cat? Where did you come from?
SAY Emi Oh, you're soaking wet! You poor little thing.

SPRITE assets/sprites/emi_smile.png center
SAY Emi Hold on, I think I have some treats in my bag.
SAY Narrator The girl named Emi reaches into her backpack, her eyes sparkling with kindness.

BG assets/backgrounds/room_interior.png
SPRITE assets/sprites/sara_stern.png center
SAY Sara Emi! What did I say about bringing "guests" into the room?
SAY Emi But Sara, look at him! He's tiny! And he's shivering!

CHOICE
OPTION Pad over to Emi -> emi_route
OPTION Sit politely in front of Sara -> sara_route
ENDCHOICE

LABEL emi_route
ADD emi_affection 1
SPRITE assets/sprites/emi_smile.png center
SAY Emi Aww, you chose me? Okay, okay, one treat. Maybe two.
SAY Narrator Emi hides her grin behind her sleeve as you bump your head against her hand.
GOTO common_evening

LABEL sara_route
ADD sara_affection 1
SPRITE assets/sprites/sara_soft.png center
SAY Sara ...You understand manners better than most people in this dorm.
SAY Narrator Sara sighs, but her hand is already reaching down to scratch behind your ears.
GOTO common_evening

LABEL common_evening
BG assets/backgrounds/cozy_bed.png
SPRITE assets/sprites/cat_hero.png center
SAY Narrator Curled up on a soft blanket, you purr loudly. The dormitory life might not be so bad after all.
SAY Narrator Later that night, the dorm grows quiet, and someone checks on you one last time.

IF emi_affection >= 1 GOTO emi_night
IF sara_affection >= 1 GOTO sara_night
GOTO neutral_night

LABEL emi_night
SPRITE assets/sprites/emi_smile.png center
SAY Emi I knew you'd pick the warmest blanket. Tomorrow, I'll find you a proper collar.
GOTO ending

LABEL sara_night
SPRITE assets/sprites/sara_soft.png center
SAY Sara You are still temporary. But... I placed a towel by the heater, just in case.
GOTO ending

LABEL neutral_night
SAY Narrator Nobody says it out loud, but the room feels a little warmer with you in it.

LABEL ending
SAY Narrator Your first night in the dormitory ends, and a new routine quietly begins.

END
